column3: Autumn term 2025 · Form tutor: Ms R. Adebayo · Base room F8
This timetable applies from Monday 8 September 2025 until the October half-term. Lessons shaded green are double lessons and take place in the same room without a break.
· PE kit is needed on Monday afternoons, including trainers for indoor use.
· Science on Wednesday morning takes place in Lab 2 while Lab 1 is refitted.
· Music on Friday is in the main hall until the music block reopens.
· Homework is set in the planner and checked during Friday form tutor time.
Pupils who arrive after 08:50 must sign in at the main office. Changes to this timetable are announced in the weekly bulletin.
